reading.body:
Moveworks's listed product is Moveworks, categorized under enterprise ai platforms & agent orchestration, with employee support automation as the function this data names first.

The data also tags Moveworks with IT service desk agent and enterprise-grade access controls, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it.

Moveworks sits at the application layer here, a product built on top of underlying compute rather than a claim on the compute itself, so this entry does not speak to the buildings or power behind it. Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to moveworks.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about Moveworks's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
Moveworks describes itself as an AI Assistant platform for an entire workforce, used to find answers instantly and automate tasks end to end across business apps. The company says the platform is available through chat, web, intranet, portals, and mobile, supports more than 100 languages, and can search user-generated content across Slack, OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, Outlook, and 50+ other systems. It is headquartered in Mountain View.

The site presents the Moveworks Reasoning Engine as an agentic AI system that orchestrates enterprise-ready LLMs and built-in tools so AI agents can understand, plan, execute, and adapt to a request. Moveworks says it provides hundreds of plugins and connectors, frameworks for integrating with other systems, analytics for fine-tuning, and low-code and vibe-code tool builders for AI agents. It also describes working with ServiceNow as one combined offering, and says it was named a Challenger in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Artificial Intelligence Applications in IT Service Management. Customer material on the site includes Micron connecting an AI front door powered by Moveworks to ServiceNow workflows, and a quote attributed to Shrini Arole of Toyota. The site also cites a report stating that 78% of executives report major operational transformation, and a healthcare customer quote referring to 300,000 colleagues and 185 million people served.

The product associated with the company is the Moveworks platform, described as employee support automation with an IT service desk agent and enterprise-grade access controls.
